mentions.name: ZooTracker
mentions.description: Free app for tracking animals seen at zoos and exploring zoo inventories. Users can look up which animals can be seen at which zoo, browse each zoo's vertebrate animal inventory, log the animals they have seen, and collect lifer lists. Available as a web app and on Android (recently promoted from closed testing to production), with an iOS app in development.
mentions.source_excerpt:
